'''Kryo Tinwole''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force Adept]] who was among the first colonists that settled on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Veroleem]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. While carrying out a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] expedition on Veroleem, Tinwole discovered the ruins of an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] laboratory. Inside the structure he recovered several Sith texts, which he used his [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] to translate, and from the writings he learned how to create an elixir of immortality. Tinwole subsequently [[Death/Legends|murdered]] one of the other colonists and used the individual's [[Brain/Legends|brain]] chemicals to manufacture a batch of the elixir, which he tested in himself. Tinwole then set about using his [[The Force/Legends|Force]] powers and his newly-gained immortality to corrupt the minds of the other colonists and forge them into a cult that became known as the "[[Cult of Veroleem]]."<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />
